title: 第9章 防有灵犀一点通第10章 进步神速

第九章 防有灵犀一点通
拉人犯规！眼看科比要突破成功，叶锋拉住了科比的胳膊。
推人犯规！奥多姆掩护，叶锋将奥多姆推了个趔趄。
撞人犯规！叶锋中路接球准备扣篮，站在篮下的中锋拉里.特纳成为了受害者，被撞飞了出去。
阻挡犯规！叶锋挡住了科比的突破。
恶意犯规！叶锋飞铲科比……
“我不是故意的，我只是滑倒了，裁判不要罚我出场啊！”叶锋拉着布莱恩.肖叫道。
布莱恩肖手指着场边，叫道：“你知道自己几次犯规了吗？你知道这个星球上的篮球比赛几次犯规要被罚出场吗？你就是大卫.斯特恩的亲儿子也该出场了！”
叶锋第二次出场三分多钟，五次犯规，效率提高了。他坐回到迪瓦茨身边，无辜道：“教练，刚才我真的是滑倒的，还有之前那次，我只是轻轻碰了科比一下，那也吹犯规？”
迪瓦茨已经快疯了，张着大嘴，呲牙道：“刚才你的膝盖都顶在科比裤裆上了，那不但是犯规，他还可以告你性骚扰！还有那个扣篮，你那是扣篮吗？你以为冲出底线会达阵得分？你真的是来试训的吗？不是仇家故意派来玩我们的吧？”
“我真的不是故意的……”叶锋捂着脸叹道，他犯规比别人得分还容易。只要有人从他身边经过，他情不自禁的就会和人来点身体接触。他的大脑没有橄榄球场上的记忆，但身体的记忆还在，对上速度快的人他甚至有直接放倒的冲动。
第一堂训练课，叶锋总共只打了8分钟，犯规10次。他的表现让边缘球员们很高兴，每个人都感觉少了个竞争对手。
训练结束后，只有拜纳姆劝慰了他。“别灰心，这只是第一天，你说不定还有机会留下的。”（大部分可能留不下了）
叶锋面无表情。“谢谢，听你这么一说我更郁闷了。”
第二天，叶锋继续分在替补队，不知道科比是不是故意，还是挡拆后和叶锋对位，对他进行惨无人道的虐待。
叶锋想了半个晚上，这次他克制自己，尽量不犯规，但不犯规，科比带球一变向就能轻松在他身边经过，投篮命中。进攻端叶锋获得了投篮机会，高位两次出手偏出，低位两次投篮偏出，四投零中，不被逼到绝路，队友们再不把球传给他，他投篮不准的毛病也被对手充分利用，对方可以在高位放他两步，包夹拜纳姆。
后来迪瓦茨让他去防守夸梅.布朗，补防的任务交给了其他人，叶锋终于可以发挥自己的力量优势。他把布朗抗在三秒区外，布朗进攻受到了限制，但黄队的进攻重心是在外线。很快新的问题又来了，叶锋不太懂卡位，对球弹出的预判也不好，没法很好的保护后场篮板球，布朗连续抢下前场篮板二次进攻得手。
被换下场的时候，叶锋对自己有些失望了。这比想象的要困难的多，今天他还是一分没得，也没助攻，唯一的数据是抢了两个篮板球。昨天收拾他的至少是科比，今天他却被水货状元欺负了。布朗作为状元很水，但和普通球员相比还是有两把刷子的。
叶锋的脸色像80块钱买了重庆啤酒的股民一样惨淡。布莱恩.肖今天没客串裁判，坐在他身边笑道：“怎么，你现在就准备放弃了？”
叶锋摇头道：“我怎么做才能进步？你能教我两手吗？”

布莱恩.肖在当球员的时候，防守也不错，他正色道：“你的问题太多了，我只能教你一点关于外线的基础知识。就说防外线吧，你的打法不对，你不要只是试图跟上科比，按照他的节奏去移动。好的防守，不只要跟上，还要试着打乱对方的节奏，你有没有发现他有很多球都是在右侧低位转身跳投的时候打进的？”
转身跳投难度很大，科比做的非常娴熟，叶锋毫无办法。“他投球难度很大，我被他晃开后很难追上去封盖，怎么才能打乱他的节奏？”
布莱恩.肖耐心的讲解：“打乱节奏是在他投篮之前，他在单打你的时候，会把球运到自己最熟悉，投篮最准的位置。而你要做的，是尽量把他逼迫到不舒服的位置接球，投篮。比如他在低位三秒区线外一步十拿九稳，如果你能把他逼到两步的位置投篮，就能降低他的命中率。”
叶锋明白一些了。“那我怎么才能不吃假动作呢？我现在别说逼他了，跟都跟不上。”
说总是容易，做起来难。布莱恩.肖笑道：“我可以教你，能领悟多少就看你自己了，防内线、防背身最重要的是抗住，防转身那一下，你做的不错。可是防外线，你太注意对手的假动作和手中的篮球，防外线的要领是在对方接球的一瞬间上去贴身，只要贴紧了，同时双手张开，对方就会没有运球的空间。要是对手接到球的时候你来不及贴身，比如对位科比，那就不要离他太近，留一步的距离，这样他运球或投篮的时候，你有时间反应。重心降低，眼睛平视对方的肩膀，因为任何的变相动作，最先动的就是肩部。另外，手要张开，如果对方朝右侧运球，防守则应当右手在前扰乱对方运球，左手横向张开控制对方突破空间。如对方向左运球则动作相反。你的脚步也不对，步子迈的太大，应该用滑步结合交叉步，对方正常运球时采用滑步防守，对方突破时应采用交叉步防守，快速变向。”
叶锋没有打岔，听的非常仔细，试图全部记在心里。作为球迷看球的时候他觉得什么都简单，现在从球员的角度看待篮球了，才知道打篮球是一门很大的学问，他以前根本不懂。想打好篮球需要花很多心思，职业球员和非职业球员之间差距太大。一个天上，一个地下。
肖就说了这么多，让他仔细观察科比的防守。叶锋知道到2007年科比已经五次入选联盟最佳防守阵容一队，到2012年共9次入选。
NBA最佳防守阵容是联盟自1968－1969赛季以来每年对常规赛中最佳防守球员们所评选出的最佳阵容。该阵容由NBA30支球队主教练投票选出，各位主教练不准投自己门下弟子的票。每位主教练分别按中锋、前锋、后卫的位置选出一队和二队球员各5名。球员获得第一阵容的选票得2分，获得第二阵容的选票得1分，最后以得分多少确定两套阵容：得分最高的5名球员组成第一阵容，排名6—10位的5名球员组成第二阵容。当得分发生并列时，将会增加最佳防守阵容的名额。
科比能进9次一阵靠的肯定不是给教练们送礼，教练们更不会是球盲，他是有绝对实力的。
叶锋坐在场下观察着科比。通常球星都不会很认真的防守，科比却在训练中都防的很卖力。奥尼尔离开后，他没有独自带队过过季后赛第一轮，他急着想要证明自己。
科比的防守强不在于大量的盖帽和抢断，而是他的经验和预判。直到科比下场，叶锋还在回味着看到的情景。迪瓦茨拍拍他肩膀道：“叶，别发呆了，准备上场。你看了这么长时间，上去试试吧。对手掩护的时候，你要注意换防。”
“明白了。”
科比下场后，换上了武贾西奇。叶锋还是作为4号位回到了场上，和他对位的人是图里亚夫。
黄队进攻。图里亚夫拉到三分线给加瓦里斯.克里坦顿做掩护。克里坦顿是今年的首轮新秀，是湖人想要好好培养的人。
叶锋绕开图里亚夫，挡在了克里坦顿的突破路线上，一步距离，注意力主要放在对方的肩膀上，脚下的步伐也改变了，他不再全速大步移动，而是用上了滑步。
克里坦顿想要突破，被叶锋挡住后立即改为了背身运球，试图寻找跑位的队友。叶锋回忆着科比的防守方式，右腿向后撤了一小步，给克里坦顿留出了带球的空间。
就像背身要位的时候如果防守人突然撤身，进攻者会惯性的向后仰，有可能摔倒。叶锋退这一步，给克里坦顿设了一个圈套，也引的他背身向前运了一步。叶锋提前判断出了他带球的方位，用左腿靠着他，让他无法起速突破，右手出击，准确的切在了篮球上，把球拍掉了，他接着向前迈了一大步，挤着克里坦顿拿住了篮球。
抢断了！其他人都觉得这是走狗屎运，没当回事。只有布莱恩.肖惊讶的嘴巴张成了O型，这不就是刚才我给他讲的东西吗？这不是科比防外线时常用的方法吗？他听了一遍，看了一会儿就自己使出来了？！
打了几个回合，克里坦顿再次利用挡拆突破，依旧被拦了下来。这一次叶锋做的更利落，刚刚挡拆，叶锋就扑上前去贴身防守，减少了克里坦顿的运球空间，迫使他只好将球传出。
布莱恩.肖现在可以肯定叶锋防外线进步了，科比不在场，他很好的完成了防挡拆的任务。

Chapter 9: Just in case there is a clear understanding
Pulling foul! Seeing that Kobe was about to make a breakthrough, Ye Feng grabbed Kobe's arm.
Foul for pushing someone! Odom covered, and Ye Feng pushed Odom staggering.
Collision foul! Ye Feng caught the ball in the middle and was about to dunk. Center Larry Turner, who was standing under the basket, became the victim and was knocked away.
Block the foul! Ye Feng blocked Kobe's breakthrough.
Flagrant foul! Ye Feng tackles Kobe...
"I didn't mean it, I just slipped. The referee shouldn't send me off!" Ye Feng pulled Brian Xiao and shouted.
Brian Shaw pointed to the sidelines and shouted: "Do you know how many times you fouled? Do you know how many times you foul in a basketball game on this planet and you will be ejected? You are David Stern's biological son and it's time to play!"
Ye Feng played for more than three minutes for the second time and committed five fouls, which improved his efficiency. He sat back down next to Divac and said innocently: "Coach, I really slipped and fell just now. And that time before, I just touched Kobe lightly. Does that call a foul?"
Divac was going crazy. He opened his mouth and bared his teeth: "Just now, your knee was on Kobe's crotch. Not only was that a foul, he can also sue you for sexual harassment! And that dunk, was that a dunk? Did you think you would score a touchdown if you crossed the baseline? Are you really here for a trial? The enemy didn't deliberately send us to play with us, right?"
"I really didn't mean it..." Ye Feng covered his face and sighed. It was easier for him to foul than others to score. As long as someone passes by him, he can't help but make some physical contact with them. His brain does not have the memory of the football field, but the memory of his body is still there. He even has the urge to knock down fast people directly.
In the first training session, Ye Feng only played a total of 8 minutes and committed 10 fouls. His performance delighted the fringe players and everyone felt like they had one less competitor.
After training, only Bynum comforted him. "Don't be discouraged. This is just the first day. You might still have a chance to stay." (Most of them may not be able to stay.)
Ye Feng's face was expressionless. "Thank you. I feel even more depressed after hearing what you said."
The next day, Ye Feng continued to be assigned to the substitute team. I don’t know if Kobe Bryant did it on purpose, or he faced Ye Feng after a pick-and-roll and subjected him to inhumane abuse.
Ye Feng thought about it for half the night. This time he restrained himself and tried not to foul. But without fouling, Kobe could easily pass by him as soon as he changed direction with the ball and made a shot. On the offensive end, Ye Feng got a chance to shoot. He missed two shots from the high post and missed two shots from the low post. He made 0 out of 4 shots. If his teammates didn't pass him the ball, his inaccurate shooting was also fully exploited by the opponent. The opponent could let him take two steps in the high post to double-team Bynum.
Later, Divac asked him to defend Kwame Brown, and the task of covering up the defense was handed over to others. Ye Feng could finally take advantage of his strength. He kept Brown outside the three-second zone, and Brown's offense was restricted, but the yellow team's offensive focus was on the outside. Soon a new problem came. Ye Feng didn't know how to block the ball, and he didn't predict the ball well. He couldn't protect the backcourt rebounds well. Brown continuously grabbed offensive rebounds and succeeded in the second attack.
When he was substituted, Ye Feng was a little disappointed with himself. This is much more difficult than expected. Today he still didn't score a point or assist. The only data he had was grabbing two rebounds. At least Kobe was the one who dealt with him yesterday, but today he was bullied by the parallel import number one pick. Brown is very good as the No. 1 pick, but compared with ordinary players, he still has two brushes.
Ye Feng's face looked as gloomy as the stock investor who bought Chongqing Beer for 80 yuan. Brian Xiao did not serve as a referee today. He sat next to him and smiled: "What, are you ready to give up now?"
Ye Feng shook his head and said: "How can I make progress? Can you teach me how to do it?"
Brian Shaw is a playerAt that time, the defense was also good. He said sternly: "You have too many questions. I can only teach you some basic knowledge about the perimeter. Let's talk about defending the perimeter. Your play style is wrong. Don't just try to keep up with Kobe and move at his rhythm. A good defense should not only keep up, but also try to disrupt the opponent's rhythm. Have you noticed that many of his goals are scored when he turns around and jumps in the low post on the right side?"
It is very difficult to turn around and jump shot. Kobe did it very skillfully and Ye Feng had no choice. "It's very difficult for him to throw the ball. After I was shaken away by him, it was difficult for me to catch up and block the shot. How can I disrupt his rhythm?"
Brian Xiao explained patiently: "The reason to disrupt the rhythm is before he shoots. When he is beating you in isolation, he will dribble the ball to the position he is most familiar with and the most accurate shooting position. What you have to do is to try to force him into an uncomfortable position to catch the ball and shoot. For example, he is sure to take one step outside the low three-second zone. If you can force him to two steps to shoot, you can reduce his shooting rate."
Ye Feng understood a little better. "Then how can I avoid using fake moves? I can't even keep up, let alone forcing him."
It's always easier said than done. Brian Xiao smiled and said: "I can teach you, it's up to you how much you can understand. The most important thing to defend against the inside line and the back is to resist. When you turn around, you did a good job. But when defending from the outside line, you pay too much attention to the opponent's fake moves and the basketball in your hand. The key to guarding against the outside line You need to get close to the opponent at the moment he catches the ball. As long as you keep close to him and open your hands at the same time, the opponent will have no room to dribble. If you don't have time to get close to the opponent when he receives the ball, such as against Kobe, then don't get too close to him and leave one step away so that he can dribble. Or when shooting, you have time to react. Lower your center of gravity and look straight at the opponent's shoulder, because in any disguised movement, the shoulder is the first to move. In addition, your hands should be open. If the opponent is dribbling to the right, the defense should use the right hand in front to disrupt the opponent's dribbling, and the left hand should be horizontal. Open up to control the opponent's breakthrough space. If the opponent dribbles to the left, the action is the opposite. Your steps are not right and the steps are too big. You should use a sliding step combined with a cross step. The opponent should use a sliding step to defend when dribbling. When the opponent breaks through, you should use a cross step to defend and change direction quickly.
Ye Feng did not interrupt and listened very carefully, trying to remember everything in his mind. When he was watching football as a fan, he thought everything was simple. Now that he looks at basketball from a player's perspective, he realizes that playing basketball is a huge subject that he didn't understand at all before. It takes a lot of effort to play basketball well, and the gap between professional players and non-professional players is too big. One is in heaven and the other is underground.
That's all Shaw said, asking him to carefully observe Kobe's defense. Ye Feng knew that by 2007, Kobe had been selected to the league's All-Defensive First Team five times, and by 2012, he had been selected for a total of nine times.
The NBA All-Defensive Team is the best team selected by the league every year since the 1968-1969 season for the best defensive players in the regular season. The lineup is voted by the head coaches of the NBA's 30 teams. Head coaches are not allowed to vote for their own disciples. Each head coach selects 5 players from the first team and 5 players from the second team according to the positions of center, forward and defender. Players get 2 points for getting votes for the first team, and 1 point for getting votes for the second team. Finally, two lineups are determined based on their scores: the five players with the highest scores form the first team, and the five players ranked 6-10 make up the second team. When a score is tied, an All-Defensive team spot will be added.
Kobe's success in scoring nine times was definitely not due to giving gifts to the coaches, and the coaches were not blind to the game. He was absolutely capable.
Ye Feng sat off the court and observed Kobe. Usually stars don't defend very seriously, but Kobe defended very hard in training. After O'Neal left, he was not aloneAfter leading the team past the first round of the playoffs, he was eager to prove himself.
Kobe's defensive strength does not lie in a large number of blocks and steals, but in his experience and anticipation. Until Kobe came off the court, Ye Feng was still thinking about what he saw. Divac patted him on the shoulder and said: "Ye, don't be in a daze, get ready to play. You've been watching for so long, go up and give it a try. When the opponent is covering, you have to pay attention to switching defenses."
"Got it."
After Kobe came off the court, he was replaced by Vujacic. Ye Feng returned to the court as the No. 4, and his opponent was Turiaf.
Yellow team attacks. Turiaf pulled to the three-point line to cover Gavaris Crittenton. Crittenton is this year's first-round pick, and he is someone the Lakers want to cultivate.
Ye Feng bypassed Turiaf and blocked Crittenton's breakthrough route. One step away, his attention was mainly on the opponent's shoulders. The pace of his feet also changed. He no longer moved at full speed, but used sliding steps.
Crittenton wanted to break through, but after being blocked by Ye Feng, he immediately changed to dribbling with his back, trying to find a running teammate. Ye Feng recalled Kobe's defensive method and took a small step back with his right leg, leaving room for Crittenton to dribble the ball.
Just like when the defender is backing up to gain position, if the defender suddenly withdraws, the attacker will lean back inertia and may fall. Ye Feng took this step back, setting a trap for Crittenton and causing him to take a step forward with his back turned. Ye Feng judged the direction in which he was dribbling the ball in advance, and leaned against him with his left leg to prevent him from breaking through at speed. He struck out with his right hand, accurately cut the basketball, and knocked the ball away. He then took a big step forward, squeezed Crittenton and grabbed the basketball.
Stealed! Others thought it was bad luck and didn't take it seriously. Only Brian Xiao's mouth opened in an O shape in surprise. Isn't this what I just told him? Isn't this a method that Kobe often uses to defend the perimeter? He listened once, watched it for a while and then used it himself? !
After a few rounds, Crittenton once again used the pick-and-roll to break through, but was still stopped. This time Ye Feng did it more neatly. Just after the pick-and-roll, Ye Feng rushed forward to defend closely, reducing Crittenton's dribbling space and forcing him to pass the ball.
Brian Shaw can now confirm that Ye Feng has improved in defending the perimeter. Kobe is not on the court, and he has completed the task of defending the pick-and-roll very well.
